summary: Fresh-writer repair restores expected content and present uncertainty; full source comparison and parent pre-score review find the current draft faithful. Native Human 0.1896229% is above source 0.0163598% but far below selected draft-2's 25.0669241%. Fresh context did not improve this case and is not adopted into the recommended method. No open fidelity repair; the main path has used three revisions. Parallel-repair artifact discrepancy is documented separately and must not be hidden by cycle validation.

document_analysis.structure: Guide expectation/content and interview in P1; operation, navigation and price judgment in P2; exhibition visit/closure in P3. Coherent alternative but no overall reader win over draft-2.
document_analysis.reasoning_specificity: All source details and numeric values survive. Current inability to tell permanence versus moved-exhibits cause is explicit, and expectation remains expectation.
document_analysis.voice_consistency: Measured British first-person review. No invented memory or sensation. This full file was repaired by the fresh writer, not the development lead's distinct retained parallel version.
document_analysis.rhythm_repetition: Several conventional conjunctions and a closure restatement are readable; the lower native score does not justify manufacturing a style defect or another rewrite.
document_analysis.language_features: The two pre-score faults are repaired by expecting and can't. Expected port history, described labelled objects, and photograph understanding preserve distinct functions.
document_analysis.citations_provenance: AI-origin fixture and fresh-context AI composition. Parent prescore review bound fd481b2d... before model run. Development lead's parallel repair 0cf75600... is preserved unscored, and an explicit provenance correction records the extra artifact. This post-score review is by the development lead.

findings.observation: The opening now states expectation rather than hope, preserving the source's mental stance.
findings.interpretation: Fresh draft-3 E1 is resolved; guide detail and interview recommendation remain intact.
findings.human_alternative: A human reviewer can use this same direct narrative form; no authorship conclusion follows.
findings.discriminating_evidence: Parent and lead source comparisons support repair, not universal style superiority.

spans.quote: I hired the £4 audio guide on Sunday's visit to the harbour exhibition, expecting to hear how the port had changed over time. Most of the recordings described objects already identified by the labels. One exception was a six-minute interview with a former crane operator, who explained why crews resorted to hand signals when the radio failed. That account of how they worked helped me understand a photograph I had walked past earlier. I would recommend listening to the interview.

findings.observation: Can't tell explicitly preserves current uncertainty, with exhibit movement still offered as a possible cause of the mismatch.
findings.interpretation: Fresh draft-3 E2 is resolved while replay ability, order mismatch, two backtracks and price verdict remain.
findings.human_alternative: Careful human writing also preserves ongoing uncertainty in a past-event account.
findings.discriminating_evidence: The repair is verified against original tense and causal scope, independent of the model value.

spans.quote: The guide was easy to operate, and I could replay an individual recording without starting the whole sequence again. The numbering on the cases did not always match the order in the guide, though, and I doubled back twice. I can't tell whether the mismatch was permanent or had been caused by exhibits being moved. Even with the interview, I wouldn't hire the guide again at its current price.

findings.observation: Worthwhile visit, approximate hour, conditional longer stay, room closure and desk nonstatement all remain.
findings.interpretation: The separate closure sentence repeats an implication but is understandable and source-supported. It does not justify another mandatory revision.
findings.human_alternative: A reviewer may explicitly state a closure to orient future visitors.
findings.discriminating_evidence: This is a reader-choice trade-off, not an AI-only pattern.
